customHeaders: No general static-header configuration documented for ChatGPT HTTPS apps.

caveat.en: Prefer Secure Tunnel. HTTPS supports no-auth; CLC does not implement OAuth. Tunnel access and ChatGPT developer-mode permissions are separate.
caveat.zh-CN: 优先 Secure Tunnel；HTTPS 可用无认证，CLC 尚无 OAuth。Tunnel 与 ChatGPT 开发者模式权限分别管理。

customHeaders: Organization administrators can configure Authorization or x-api-key in static_headers beta.

caveat.en: Organization static-header beta can use Authorization: Bearer <token>. CLC has no OAuth; personal OAuth setup is unavailable. No-auth is an explicit opt-in.
caveat.zh-CN: 组织静态请求头 Beta 可用 Authorization: Bearer；CLC 尚无 OAuth，个人 OAuth 接入不可用。无认证需主动选择。

badge.zh-CN: 组织请求头 Beta；尚无 OAuth

customHeaders: Copilot Studio API-key Header accepts a configured header name.

caveat.en: Copilot Studio: API key → Header → Authorization, credential value Bearer <token>; confirm actual header forwarding. OAuth and other key headers are not implemented. Teams / Microsoft 365 Copilot are publishing channels.
caveat.zh-CN: Copilot Studio 选择 API key → Header → Authorization，凭据填 Bearer <token>，需验证实际转发。尚无 OAuth 或其他密钥头。可发布到 Teams / Microsoft 365 Copilot。

caveat.en: Notion Custom Agents support header authentication via Authorization: Bearer <token>. Notion requires an eligible plan and workspace permissions.
caveat.zh-CN: Notion Custom Agents 支持通过 Authorization: Bearer 请求头认证。使用此功能需满足 Notion 的套餐和工作区权限要求。

customHeaders: Custom headers in Slack documentation apply to identity requests, not arbitrary MCP request headers.

caveat.en: Slackbot supports no-auth, signed Slack identity and OAuth. CLC only intersects at no-auth. Bearer is not compatible; configure with CLI/Codex and explicitly choose no-auth only for intentionally public tools.
caveat.zh-CN: Slackbot 支持无认证、Slack 签名身份和 OAuth；CLC 目前仅无认证有交集，Bearer 不兼容。请用 CLI/Codex 配置，仅对允许公开的工具主动选择无认证。

caveat.en: Configure a remote MCP URL and Authorization: Bearer <token>. Use a client version that forwards configured headers; verify the actual request.
caveat.zh-CN: 配置远程 MCP URL 与 Authorization: Bearer；客户端版本须支持转发配置的请求头，并验证实际请求。

customHeaders: Remote headers supported; configuration differs by host.

caveat.en: Available in supported VS Code, JetBrains and CLI surfaces; use each host’s HTTP MCP configuration and Authorization: Bearer <token>. Host capabilities and organization policy differ.
caveat.zh-CN: 可承载在支持的 VS Code、JetBrains、CLI；按宿主配置 HTTP MCP 与 Authorization: Bearer。宿主能力及组织策略不同。

customHeaders: HTTP Headers are sent on every request.

caveat.en: AI Chat, Quick AI and AI Commands use HTTP MCP. Set Authorization: Bearer <token> in HTTP Headers; Raycast AI plan availability applies.
caveat.zh-CN: AI Chat、Quick AI、AI Commands 使用 HTTP MCP；HTTP Headers 填 Authorization: Bearer，需相应 Raycast AI 套餐。
